question: Xi Jinping out before 2027?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if China's General Secretary of the Communist Party, Xi Jinping, is removed from power for any length of time between July 3, 2025, and December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping will be considered removed from power if he announces his resignation from his role as General Secretary, or is otherwise dismissed, detained, disqualified, or otherwise loses his position or is prevented from fulfilling his duties as General Secretary within this market's timeframe.

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

Decades of power consolidation, including 2018 term-limit changes and loyalist placements across the Politburo and security apparatus, have eliminated visible factional rivals, with recent military leadership adjustments further aligning elite incentives ahead of the 21st Party Congress. Public continuity in policy and appearances through mid-2026 shows no elite realignment or health signals capable of forcing an abrupt exit outside scheduled party mechanisms. Low-probability shifts could still arise from an unforeseen medical event, acute economic pressures prompting internal consensus against him, or an external crisis fracturing cohesion before December 2026.
